text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it is even more charming up close. 
The outfit is crafted with such intricate 
detail...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
From the hairstyle to the ear ornaments... 
fufu. 
It reminds me of playing with dolls long 
ago.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
There were times I would match my own 
clothes 
and hair to my dolls. How nostalgic.
